homer.mp4.title: homer
homer.mp4.abstract: this is a video work about monumental sculpture. It was made firstly by carving a head meant to represent Homer Simpson out of sandstone. The video was made with a canon gl2 mini dv converted to digital with vcr and screen recording. Edited in premiere pro. It is important to me because I feel like I will in the future be able to look back on it as one of my early explorations of stone sculpture, and its use in video.
homer.mp4.note: Definitely going to work on my stone carving skills. Forgot to give music credit

taj_salo_00.mp4.title: alloces
taj_salo_00.mp4.abstract: this is an exploration of the design process. The video was made using premiere pro and photoshop using footage from a canon gl2 on minidv converted to digital through vcr playback and screen recording. I made the audio in Ryans class. I made the node map using claude code building from scratch. I think this is important because it shows the steps taken in an iterative process. To me I think this process is far more important than the final video because no matter what I do in the future, it will always in some way be built through all of my past experiences.
taj_salo_00.mp4.note: In the map itself I have a few relatively less grandiose images that I wouldn't mind putting in a portfolio of sorts [such as alkmm1 G35.png, which became a 24'x36'print]. I’d like to come up with an idea for displaying things other than as big projects. I met this super cool guy called Ilya Duganov who gave a very inspiring presentation with his portfolio
taj_salo_00.mp4.fileNote: the final culmination of the iterative process for this project

sw4.mp4.abstract: its something. Made with premiere pro. Canon gl2 mini dv converted with vcr mode and screen recording. Found footage was also used. Audio was found. I think its important because it shows some things I can do with video editing
